Roth }} '''Mirage Archer''' is a [[support gem]] that causes linked bow skills to summon a ghostly archer. When the player hits an enemy with the supported skill, a temporary Mirage Archer is summoned above the player which uses that skill. == Skill Functions and Interactions == ===Distinct entity=== The Mirage Archer is a distinct entity, and as such, the following apply: *[[Leech]]: Players do not [[leech]] from the damage dealt by the Mirage Archer. *[[Charge|Charge]]: Mirage Archer cannot have [[charge]]s, even when using [[Frenzy]] or [[Curse]]s. In the event they do, charges have no effect on Mirage Archers. *[[Ancestral Bond]]: The Mirage Archer may still deal damage if the [[Ancestral Bond]] Keystone is taken. *On Hit/Kill: The Mirage Archer does not trigger the player's on hit or on kill effects. Like a [[Totem]], the mirage archer uses your skill and deals your damage, so most effects that apply to nearby [[Ally|allies]] will have no effect on it. Also like a totem, the archer has its own [[Action speed]] and its attack rate is not affected by [[Chill]] or [[Freeze]] inflicted on the player. ===Dps calculation=== Equipping a level 20 Mirage Archer with 0% quality translates to '''27.6%''' more damage per second: {{math|formula=(1 - (31 / 100)) * (1 - (60 / 100)) = 0.276|display=inline}} ==Gem level progression== {{Skill progression | c1_header = Mirage Archer deals x% less Damage with Supported Skills | c1_abbr = less
